title: Principle 1: Metalearning: first draw a map
coreMove: Map why, what, and how before sprinting, then revise the map when the project teaches back.
sourcePressure: Metalearning researches purpose, skill components, and methods before and during a project so effort has direction without becoming rigid. The source sidecar contains no named people, studies, institutions, places, dates, or artifacts for this chapter, so named source anchors must be omitted rather than invented.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Turning mapping into endless research or a fixed recipe that keeps the learner away from the skill.

hook: Ch4: learner stares at browser tabs and realizes motivation is not enough
Ch4: broad modern world pressure opener
counterintuition: The obvious move is not the real move
Most people think more effort is enough
This is not about working harder
tryThisNow: Spend one minute thinking about your learning journey
examples: desk plus laptop plus vague course collection
manager in a recurring meeting with no concrete artifact

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples, drawn from: timestamp+name+action, dialogue first line, sensory detail first, second-person You direct address, retrospective It took her three weeks to see, question-as-hook, environmental detail before any human
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches Cartesian repetition of phrases but not the deeper template of 'timestamp + named protagonist + prop + decision' that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps

exampleSpecs.domain: Grace, a biotech technician mapping why she needs statistics for assay design
exampleSpecs.audience: a learner who has been mistaking motion for progress
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether the next month produces visible evidence or another private feeling of effort
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Grace writes why the assay statistics matter, what analyses actually belong, and how she will test each one against lab data.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a microplate reader printout under a three-column map

exampleSpecs.domain: Andrew, a community-college student splitting cybersecurity into subskills
exampleSpecs.audience: a practitioner under a near-term performance constraint
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether a deadline exposes the weakness early enough to adjust
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Andrew splits cybersecurity into network basics, threat modeling, and lab practice before choosing the first module.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: an ethernet patch cable looped around a college catalog

exampleSpecs.domain: Juliette, a pastry apprentice choosing between recipe memorization and hands-on batches
exampleSpecs.audience: a learner who has been mistaking motion for progress
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether the learner keeps credibility with a reviewer, client, teacher, or team
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Juliette discovers recipe memorization is the wrong method and adds two timed batch tests to her map.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a tray of unfilled tart shells beside a butter-smeared notebook

exampleSpecs.domain: Lukas, a city planner comparing learning methods for zoning software
exampleSpecs.audience: a practitioner under a near-term performance constraint
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether the project survives contact with a real schedule and real standards
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Lukas compares three zoning-software learning methods against the permit review he must perform, then crosses out the prettiest tutorial.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a zoning variance packet spread beside a mouse with a worn scroll wheel

exampleSpecs.domain: Adaeze, a choir director mapping a conducting skill before festival season
exampleSpecs.audience: a learner who has been mistaking motion for progress
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether comfort keeps protecting the exact skill gap that matters
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Adaeze maps conducting into score reading, gesture, rehearsal language, and festival constraints before touching the baton.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a choir score propped against a wooden music stand

exampleSpecs.domain: Anders, a nonprofit grant writer revising the map after first contact with real proposals
exampleSpecs.audience: a practitioner under a near-term performance constraint
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether the next attempt changes the skill instead of decorating the plan
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Anders revises the grant-writing map after the first real proposal shows that budget narrative, not storytelling, is the weak terrain.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a grant budget grid with one column circled in blue

skillTargets: map why, what, and how for a target skill
revise a learning map after first contact with the task
avoid using research as a refuge from action

tryThisNowSpec: Draw a three-column map labeled why, what, and how for one target skill, leaving one blank where research is still needed.

rhythmVariety.deepReadParagraphLengthMix: at least one paragraph 3 sentences or shorter, at least one paragraph 5+ sentences, at least one one-sentence punch line
rhythmVariety.fullReadInterludeRequirement: at least one paragraph that breaks the scene-then-rule rhythm: a question to the reader, a research aside, a direct second-person passage, or a brief historical reference
rhythmVariety.forbiddenRhythm: every paragraph following the pattern 'concrete anchor sentence -> abstract rule sentence -> elaboration sentence'
